heuristics.rule: All OPT must be directly related to the student's major area of study
heuristics.condition: When an F-1 student applies for or engages in any OPT (pre- or post-completion)
heuristics.action: Ensure all employment is directly related to the major area of study listed on the Form I-20
heuristics.because: OPT is defined as temporary employment directly related to the F-1 student's major area of study; unrelated employment does not qualify

heuristics.rule: Pre-completion OPT requires one full academic year of full-time enrollment at an SEVP-certified institution
heuristics.condition: When an F-1 student wants to apply for pre-completion OPT
heuristics.action: Confirm the student has been lawfully enrolled on a full-time basis for one full academic year at an SEVP-certified institution before applying
heuristics.because: Enrollment for one full academic year is a prerequisite eligibility condition for pre-completion OPT

heuristics.rule: The one full academic year enrollment requirement can be satisfied under a prior nonimmigrant status
heuristics.condition: When an F-1 student has spent part of the academic year in a different nonimmigrant status
heuristics.action: Count time enrolled full-time regardless of whether the student held F-1 status during that time
heuristics.because: USCIS explicitly states the student does not need to have had F-1 status for the one full academic year

heuristics.rule: Pre-completion OPT work is limited to 20 hours or less per week while school is in session
heuristics.condition: When a student is authorized for pre-completion OPT and school is in session
heuristics.action: Work no more than 20 hours per week
heuristics.because: USCIS explicitly caps pre-completion OPT hours at 20 per week during session; full-time is permitted only when school is not in session

heuristics.rule: Post-completion OPT requires working at least 20 hours per week
heuristics.condition: When a student is authorized for post-completion OPT
heuristics.action: Work part time (at least 20 hours per week) or full time
heuristics.because: USCIS requires a minimum of 20 hours per week for post-completion OPT authorization to be valid

heuristics.rule: All pre-completion OPT periods are deducted from post-completion OPT
heuristics.condition: When a student has used any pre-completion OPT
heuristics.action: Subtract pre-completion OPT time used from the 12-month post-completion OPT allowance at the same rate: part-time pre-completion OPT is deducted at 50%, full-time pre-completion OPT at 100%
heuristics.because: USCIS states all periods of pre-completion OPT will be deducted from the available period of post-completion OPT

heuristics.rule: One year of full-time pre-completion OPT eliminates all post-completion OPT eligibility
heuristics.condition: When a student has already received 1 year of full-time (40 hours per week) pre-completion OPT
heuristics.action: Do not apply for post-completion OPT; no authorization remains
heuristics.because: Full-time pre-completion OPT is deducted at 100%, leaving zero months of post-completion OPT available

heuristics.rule: One year of part-time pre-completion OPT reduces post-completion OPT to 6 months
heuristics.condition: When a student has already received 1 year of part-time (20 hours per week) pre-completion OPT
heuristics.action: Recognize only 6 months of full-time post-completion OPT remains available
heuristics.because: Part-time pre-completion OPT is deducted at 50%; 50% of 12 months = 6 months deducted, leaving 6 months remaining

heuristics.rule: STEM OPT extension requires the employer to be enrolled in and using E-Verify
heuristics.condition: When an F-1 student with a STEM degree applies for the 24-month STEM OPT extension
heuristics.action: Confirm the employer is enrolled in and actively using E-Verify before applying
heuristics.because: E-Verify enrollment and use by the employer is a mandatory eligibility condition for the STEM OPT extension

heuristics.rule: STEM OPT extension requires that the initial post-completion OPT was based on the STEM degree
heuristics.condition: When a student seeks the 24-month STEM OPT extension
heuristics.action: Verify that the initial grant of post-completion OPT employment authorization was based on the student's STEM degree
heuristics.because: This is an explicit eligibility condition listed by USCIS for the STEM OPT extension

heuristics.rule: Post-completion OPT application must be filed within 30 days of DSO SEVIS recommendation and no later than 60 days after degree completion
heuristics.condition: When an F-1 student applies for post-completion OPT
heuristics.action: File Form I-765 within 30 days after the DSO enters the recommendation into SEVIS, and no later than 60 days after completing the degree
heuristics.because: USCIS specifies both a 30-day filing window after DSO recommendation and a 60-day outer deadline after degree completion

heuristics.rule: Post-completion OPT application may be filed up to 90 days before degree completion
heuristics.condition: When an F-1 student wants to begin OPT immediately after graduation
heuristics.action: Apply up to 90 days before completing the degree to allow USCIS processing time
heuristics.because: USCIS explicitly permits filing up to 90 days before degree completion for post-completion OPT

heuristics.rule: STEM OPT extension must be filed within 60 days of DSO SEVIS recommendation and up to 90 days before OPT expiration
heuristics.condition: When an F-1 student with a STEM degree applies for the 24-month extension
heuristics.action: File within 60 days after DSO recommendation; may file up to 90 days before current OPT expires
heuristics.because: USCIS specifies these exact filing windows for the STEM OPT extension application

heuristics.rule: Timely filed STEM OPT extension triggers automatic 180-day employment authorization extension
heuristics.condition: When a student files the STEM OPT extension on time and OPT expires while the extension is pending
heuristics.action: USCIS will automatically extend employment authorization for 180 days while the application is pending
heuristics.because: USCIS explicitly states this automatic 180-day bridge applies when the extension is filed on time and OPT expires during adjudication

heuristics.rule: School transfer or new education level automatically terminates OPT employment authorization
heuristics.condition: When an F-1 student transfers to another school or begins studies at a new educational level while on OPT
heuristics.action: Cease employment; OPT authorization is automatically terminated upon transfer or new education level
heuristics.because: USCIS explicitly states OPT employment authorization will automatically terminate in these circumstances

heuristics.rule: Cap-gap extension requires a timely filed H-1B petition with a change of status request
heuristics.condition: When an F-1 student's OPT will expire before October 1 and an H-1B petition has been filed
heuristics.action: Ensure the H-1B petition includes a change of status request and was timely filed to qualify for the cap-gap extension
heuristics.because: USCIS states both conditions — timely filing and inclusion of a change of status request — are required for cap-gap eligibility

decision_factors.factor: Whether the employment is directly related to the student's major area of study
decision_factors.why_it_matters: OPT is only authorized for employment directly related to the major; unrelated work is unauthorized employment
decision_factors.how_to_assess: Compare the job duties to the field of study listed on Form I-20

decision_factors.factor: Amount and type (full-time vs. part-time) of pre-completion OPT already used
decision_factors.why_it_matters: Pre-completion OPT is deducted from post-completion OPT; full-time deduction is at 100%, part-time at 50%
decision_factors.how_to_assess: Review SEVIS records for authorized pre-completion OPT periods and compute remaining post-completion OPT availability

decision_factors.factor: Whether the degree is on the STEM Designated Degree Program List
decision_factors.why_it_matters: Determines eligibility for the 24-month STEM OPT extension, which can provide up to 36 months total OPT
decision_factors.how_to_assess: Check the STEM Designated Degree Program List published by USCIS/ICE

decision_factors.factor: Whether the employer is enrolled in and using E-Verify
decision_factors.why_it_matters: E-Verify enrollment and active use is a mandatory eligibility condition for the STEM OPT extension
decision_factors.how_to_assess: Confirm employer E-Verify participation status before filing the STEM OPT extension

decision_factors.factor: Timing of Form I-765 filing relative to DSO SEVIS recommendation and degree completion
decision_factors.why_it_matters: Post-completion OPT must be filed within 30 days of DSO recommendation and no later than 60 days after degree completion; missing these windows disqualifies the application
decision_factors.how_to_assess: Track the date the DSO enters the SEVIS recommendation and the degree completion date; calculate both deadlines

decision_factors.factor: Whether the initial post-completion OPT was based on the STEM degree
decision_factors.why_it_matters: STEM OPT extension requires that the initial OPT grant was based on the STEM degree; OPT based on a different degree does not qualify
decision_factors.how_to_assess: Verify the degree on which OPT was granted matches the STEM degree being cited for the extension

decision_factors.factor: Whether the H-1B petition includes a change of status request and was timely filed
decision_factors.why_it_matters: Both conditions are required to qualify for the cap-gap extension bridging F-1/OPT status to October 1
decision_factors.how_to_assess: Confirm the petition includes Form I-539 change of status and was filed within the H-1B cap filing window

hidden_tradeoffs.unstated_consequence: Every period of pre-completion OPT directly reduces post-completion OPT availability at the same education level; full-time pre-completion OPT eliminates all post-completion OPT
hidden_tradeoffs.who_it_affects: Students who use significant pre-completion OPT and then need maximum post-completion OPT time for job searching or H-1B cap-gap coverage

hidden_tradeoffs.choice: Transferring to a new school or beginning a new education level while on OPT
hidden_tradeoffs.unstated_consequence: OPT employment authorization automatically terminates upon transfer or new education level, even though F-1 status itself is not affected
hidden_tradeoffs.who_it_affects: Students who plan to continue working on OPT while transitioning between institutions or degree levels

hidden_tradeoffs.choice: Filing the STEM OPT extension late (after the 60-day DSO recommendation window)
hidden_tradeoffs.unstated_consequence: Loss of the automatic 180-day employment authorization bridge; if OPT expires during adjudication of a late filing, work authorization lapses
hidden_tradeoffs.who_it_affects: STEM students who delay working with their DSO or delay filing after the DSO recommendation is entered in SEVIS

hidden_tradeoffs.choice: Applying for post-completion OPT close to the 60-day post-graduation deadline
hidden_tradeoffs.unstated_consequence: USCIS processing times may result in a gap between graduation and EAD receipt, as the application window closes 60 days after degree completion regardless of processing speed
hidden_tradeoffs.who_it_affects: Students who wait to apply after graduation rather than applying up to 90 days before degree completion

failure_patterns.pattern: Working without authorization — including working in a field unrelated to the major or exceeding hour limits
failure_patterns.why_it_happens: OPT is limited to employment directly related to the major; pre-completion OPT is capped at 20 hours per week while school is in session
failure_patterns.consequence: Removal from the United States and reentry bars
warning_signs: Student accepts employment in a field unrelated to their I-20 major
Student works more than 20 hours per week during school session on pre-completion OPT

failure_patterns.pattern: Missing the post-completion OPT application deadlines
failure_patterns.why_it_happens: Application must be filed within 30 days of DSO SEVIS recommendation and no later than 60 days after degree completion; missing either deadline voids eligibility
failure_patterns.consequence: Loss of OPT employment authorization eligibility for that degree level
warning_signs: Student delays asking DSO for recommendation until after graduation
Student waits more than 30 days after DSO enters recommendation to file Form I-765

failure_patterns.pattern: Filing STEM OPT extension after the 60-day DSO recommendation window
failure_patterns.why_it_happens: STEM OPT extension must be filed within 60 days of DSO SEVIS recommendation; late filing forfeits the automatic 180-day employment authorization bridge
failure_patterns.consequence: Loss of automatic 180-day employment authorization extension; potential gap in work authorization if OPT expires during adjudication
warning_signs: Student delays consulting DSO about STEM extension
Student files Form I-765 more than 60 days after DSO enters SEVIS recommendation

failure_patterns.pattern: Continuing to work on OPT after transferring schools or starting a new education level
failure_patterns.why_it_happens: OPT employment authorization automatically terminates upon school transfer or new education level enrollment
failure_patterns.consequence: Unauthorized employment, with consequences including removal and reentry bars
warning_signs: Student accepts transfer to a new SEVP-certified institution while on OPT
Student enrolls in a graduate program after completing an undergraduate degree while OPT is active

failure_patterns.pattern: Assuming full post-completion OPT is available after having used full-time pre-completion OPT
failure_patterns.why_it_happens: Students may not realize that 1 year of full-time pre-completion OPT reduces post-completion OPT to zero
failure_patterns.consequence: No post-completion OPT employment authorization remains; unauthorized work if employment continues
warning_signs: Student used 12 months of full-time (40 hours/week) pre-completion OPT
Student does not check remaining OPT balance before planning post-graduation employment

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the F-1 student been lawfully enrolled on a full-time basis for one full academic year at an SEVP-certified institution?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student meets the minimum enrollment prerequisite for pre-completion OPT
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Proceed to evaluate other pre-completion OPT eligibility criteria
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Student is not yet eligible for pre-completion OPT; must complete one full academic year first

diagnostic_questions.question: How much pre-completion OPT has the student already used, and was it part-time or full-time?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: The remaining post-completion OPT available; full-time pre-completion OPT deducts at 100%, part-time at 50%
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Calculate remaining post-completion OPT: subtract deduction from 12 months
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: If no pre-completion OPT used, full 12 months of post-completion OPT is available

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the student's degree on the STEM Designated Degree Program List?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student is eligible for the 24-month STEM OPT extension
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Confirm employer E-Verify enrollment and that initial OPT was based on the STEM degree; proceed with STEM extension application
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Student is limited to the standard 12-month post-completion OPT; no STEM extension available

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the employer enrolled in and actively using E-Verify?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether a mandatory eligibility condition for the STEM OPT extension is satisfied
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Proceed with STEM OPT extension application if other criteria are met
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Student is ineligible for STEM OPT extension with this employer; must find an E-Verify employer or forego the extension

diagnostic_questions.question: Was the initial post-completion OPT granted based on the STEM degree now being cited for the extension?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the third eligibility condition for the STEM OPT extension is satisfied
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: This condition is met; evaluate remaining STEM extension criteria
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Student does not meet this condition and is ineligible for the STEM OPT extension

diagnostic_questions.question: Has the student filed Form I-765 within 30 days of the DSO's SEVIS recommendation and no later than 60 days after degree completion?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the post-completion OPT application was filed within both required time windows
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Application is timely; proceed with normal adjudication
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Application is out of time; student has lost post-completion OPT eligibility for this degree level

diagnostic_questions.question: Does the student's H-1B petition include a change of status request and was it timely filed?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the student qualifies for a cap-gap extension to bridge F-1/OPT status to October 1
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Student may be eligible for cap-gap extension; confirm both conditions are met
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Student does not qualify for cap-gap; must ensure OPT remains valid until H-1B start date or depart and reenter on H-1B

diagnostic_questions.question: Is the student planning to transfer schools or begin a new education level while OPT is active?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether OPT employment authorization will automatically terminate
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: OPT will automatically terminate; student must stop working and plan accordingly
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: OPT authorization is not affected by this factor; continue monitoring other compliance requirements

industry_realities.common_belief: Using pre-completion OPT does not affect the amount of post-completion OPT available
industry_realities.actual_reality: All pre-completion OPT periods are deducted from post-completion OPT: part-time pre-completion OPT deducts at 50%, full-time at 100%; one year of full-time pre-completion OPT eliminates all post-completion OPT
industry_realities.implication: Students must carefully weigh whether pre-completion OPT is worth the reduction in post-completion OPT, especially for H-1B cap-gap planning

industry_realities.common_belief: F-1 status requires the student to have held F-1 status for the full academic year to qualify for OPT
industry_realities.actual_reality: USCIS explicitly states the student does not need to have had F-1 status for the one full academic year; time in another nonimmigrant status counts toward the enrollment requirement
industry_realities.implication: Students who changed from another nonimmigrant status (e.g., J-1) to F-1 mid-year may be eligible for OPT sooner than they realize

industry_realities.common_belief: OPT employment authorization continues unaffected if a student transfers to a new school
industry_realities.actual_reality: OPT employment authorization automatically terminates when a student transfers to another school or begins studies at a new educational level, even though F-1 status itself is not affected
industry_realities.implication: Students who transfer while on OPT must immediately stop working; continuing to work after transfer constitutes unauthorized employment

industry_realities.common_belief: If a STEM OPT extension is pending when OPT expires, work authorization automatically continues indefinitely
industry_realities.actual_reality: The automatic extension of employment authorization is exactly 180 days — not indefinite — and only applies if the STEM OPT extension was filed on time
industry_realities.implication: Students filing STEM OPT extensions must file on time to receive the 180-day bridge; a late filing forfeits this protection

industry_realities.common_belief: Post-completion OPT can be applied for at any time after graduation
industry_realities.actual_reality: Post-completion OPT must be applied for within 30 days of DSO SEVIS recommendation and no later than 60 days after degree completion; there is no ability to apply outside these windows
industry_realities.implication: Students must engage their DSO proactively before or immediately after graduation to avoid missing the filing window

industry_realities.common_belief: Any employment after graduation on OPT is acceptable as long as the student has an EAD
industry_realities.actual_reality: OPT employment must be directly related to the student's major area of study; an EAD alone does not authorize unrelated work
industry_realities.implication: Students must evaluate each job offer against their declared major, not simply whether they hold an EAD card

junior_vs_senior_signals.dimension: Understanding the pre-completion OPT deduction from post-completion OPT
junior_vs_senior_signals.naive_pattern: Assumes pre- and post-completion OPT are independent 12-month buckets and uses both freely without calculating the deduction
junior_vs_senior_signals.informed_pattern: Calculates remaining post-completion OPT by applying the 50% deduction for part-time and 100% deduction for full-time pre-completion OPT used before applying for post-completion OPT
junior_vs_senior_signals.why_it_matters: Using too much pre-completion OPT can eliminate post-completion OPT entirely, leaving no H-1B cap-gap bridge or job search period after graduation

junior_vs_senior_signals.naive_pattern: Waits until after graduation to start the OPT process, assuming there is ample time post-graduation to apply
junior_vs_senior_signals.informed_pattern: Applies up to 90 days before degree completion to ensure the EAD is received promptly after graduation, while staying within the 30-day post-DSO-recommendation and 60-day post-graduation filing windows
junior_vs_senior_signals.why_it_matters: Late application risks a gap in work authorization or missing the filing window entirely, forfeiting OPT eligibility

junior_vs_senior_signals.naive_pattern: Assumes the STEM extension can be filed anytime before OPT expires and that a pending application always provides continued work authorization
junior_vs_senior_signals.informed_pattern: Files the STEM OPT extension within 60 days of DSO SEVIS recommendation and up to 90 days before OPT expiration to secure the automatic 180-day bridge authorization
junior_vs_senior_signals.why_it_matters: A late filing forfeits the 180-day automatic extension, creating a gap in work authorization if adjudication is not completed before OPT expires

junior_vs_senior_signals.dimension: Employer E-Verify check for STEM OPT
junior_vs_senior_signals.naive_pattern: Assumes any employer can sponsor a STEM OPT extension as long as they are willing to employ the student
junior_vs_senior_signals.informed_pattern: Verifies employer E-Verify enrollment and active use before accepting the job offer and filing the STEM OPT extension, knowing this is a hard eligibility condition
junior_vs_senior_signals.why_it_matters: An employer not enrolled in E-Verify disqualifies the student from the STEM OPT extension regardless of other factors

junior_vs_senior_signals.dimension: Impact of school transfer or new education level on OPT
junior_vs_senior_signals.naive_pattern: Assumes OPT continues through a school transfer or when starting a graduate program because F-1 status is maintained
junior_vs_senior_signals.informed_pattern: Recognizes that while F-1 status is not affected, OPT employment authorization automatically terminates upon transfer or new education level enrollment and plans work accordingly
junior_vs_senior_signals.why_it_matters: Continuing to work after OPT terminates due to a transfer constitutes unauthorized employment, risking removal and reentry bars
